2607.06527.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
2607.06527.paper_summary: Multi-hop Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs faces a critical challenge: traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines break differentiability, preventing the retriever from learning to bridge the semantic gap where intermediate nodes lack lexical overlap with the query. To address this, we propose RSF-GLLM, a framework decoupling differentiable graph reasoning from answer generation. Our Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module employs a GRU-guided query updater to propagate continuous relevance scores, utilizing a dynamic gating mechanism to traverse semantically dissimilar bridge nodes via structural cues. We introduce flow sparsity regularization to theoretically guarantee convergence from soft probabilities to discrete reasoning paths. These paths are extracted and textualized to fine-tune a Large Language Model (LLM), ensuring generation is grounded in factual topology. Experiments on WebQSP and CWQ demonstrate that RSF-GLLM achieves competitive performance with superior inference efficiency compared to LLM based computationally expensive approaches.
2607.06527.paper_summary_zh: 多跳問題回答在知識圖譜上面臨一個關鍵挑戰：傳統的檢索-再讀取管道破壞了可微分性，阻止了檢索器學習彌合中間節點與查詢之間缺乏詞彙重疊的語義差距。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了RSF-GLLM，一個將可微分圖推理與答案生成解耦的框架。我們的遞迴軟流（RSF）模組利用GRU引導的查詢更新器來傳播連續的相關性分數，利用動態閘機制通過結構線索遍歷語義上不相似的橋接節點。我們引入流稀疏正則化，理論上保證從軟概率收斂到離散推理路徑。這些路徑被提取並轉換為文本，以微調大型語言模型（LLM），確保生成的內容基於事實拓撲。在WebQSP和CWQ上的實驗表明，RSF-GLLM在推理效率上優於基於LLM的計算昂貴的方法，實現了競爭力的性能。
2607.06527.author: Sambaran Bandyopadhyay et.al.
